required_repairs.detail: The desired refined collapse must be adapted simultaneously to the actual PL map/target simplex cuts and the finite foreign-contact polyhedra. The current paragraph says to cone intersection cells from barycenters and remove cone/free-face pairs in reverse face order, but does not specify the local refined cells/pairs through those cuts or prove their free-face order relative the unchanged old base and adjoining pairs. An arbitrary compatible triangulation is not by itself a certificate of an actual simplicial collapse. Give the specifically adapted coned/derived construction for one known elementary pair, identify its retained old base and actual local pair order, show compatibility on shared faces and with the finite cuts, then iterate the already known collapse list. The author confirms this is the intended construction and that its complete local order is not currently listed. Do not replace this with simple-homotopy equivalence or smoothing a PL ambient homeomorphism.

positive_checks: A: the pinched prism is a finite polyhedron; stationarity on D makes its descended map continuous; the displayed staircase collapse has the stated free-face order, including simplices meeting D.
A: relative p-connectivity supplies the finite endpoint-fixed homotopy of a dimension-at-most-p polyhedron into U relative D; compactness keeps its bottom in U.
B/E: for every active dimension j<=p<=m-3 and shield s<=m-3, max((j+1)+j-m,(j+1)+s-m)<=j-2. Prescribed common faces must remain excluded from foreign counts as stated.

C: once the actual compatible collapse is available, decreasing-dimension interchange and the first reverse stage containing the bad subpolyhedron give an added auxiliary of dimension at most d+1. This bounds added cells, not the possibly j-dimensional base.

D: on an actual smoothly embedded simplex the barycentric field preserves the coordinate sum, decreases all non-apex coordinates, fixes the old base, and enters the already covered collar in a uniform finite time. Compact support gives actual forward and inverse smooth ambient flows. No PL homeomorphism is being declared smooth.

D/E: actual finite cutoffs can avoid the closed shield because remaining foreign contacts are confined to the retained covered base. The induction moves the open target and keeps the specified PL polyhedra fixed, avoiding a false claim about images of PL complexes under arbitrary diffeomorphisms.

F: a finite active subpolyhedron and the inactive closed shield handle compact difference. Supports lie in a relatively compact open set chosen after all finite witnesses; prescribed smaller support/control needs the explicitly supplied localized witnesses.

All dimensions p<=m-3, including m=5,p=2, use the same inequalities and smooth simplex flow; no Whitney move is used. Each fixed input uses finite operations; the stated countable collection of independent finite inputs needs only Countable Choice, not a hidden adaptive infinite schedule.
